scope: Five downloaded originals and twelve filename-only renames; current registration and availability supersede prior acquisition status, not historical scientific facts.

documents.accessNote: Local user-provided PDF received and fingerprinted. Availability, source review and adoption remain separate.

facts.statement: All following quantitative measurements are on174Yb; natural-isotope survey does not make these171Yb data.

Fluorescence ratio mean1.21e-7, standard deviation0.39e-7; authors call it a lower limit on total branching because only cascades terminating in3P1 are detected. This is not direct1P1-to-single-lower-state beta.

documents.boundary: Original plus erratum available and identity read; no production atomic value changes. Read jointly with erratum; absolute leakage comparison to Porsev theory remains an unresolved experimental/theory issue.

facts.statement: Correct3D1/3D2 lifetimes380ns/460ns, correct398nm to399nm and796nm to798nm.
No correction to branching lower limit is stated. These quoted D-state lifetimes are not a new direct lifetime measurement and do not override more recent adopted lifetime sources.

documents.title: Power-dependent loss from an ytterbium magneto-optic trap
documents.neededFor: 核对¹⁷⁴Yb MOT模型相关的有效级联损失率、激发比例和实验/理论差异。
documents.accessNote: Local user-provided PDF received and fingerprinted. Availability, source review and adoption remain separate.

facts.statement: Remainder of experiments focuses on174Yb MOT. Excited fraction f modeled using trap-volume energy density, detuning and saturation.
Experiment effective cascade rate a2,0=23(11)s^-1; cited previous a1=21.3(2.6)s^-1; predicted6.6(4.6) and5.2(2.6)s^-1 respectively.
Authors say experimental absolute rates exceed theory by about4; ratio agrees within uncertainties; discrepancy cause unresolved. Excited-state fraction uncertainty around50% dominates inferred a2,0.

documents.boundary: MOT model-dependent effective cascade population rates; not direct fine-structure beta and not171Yb hyperfine-resolved decay validation.

documents.title: Lifetimes of Rydberg levels in the perturbed 6snp 3P2 series of ytterbium I
documents.neededFor: Primary neutral-Yb perturbedP-series lifetimes and perturber sensitivity; not65S values
documents.accessNote: Local user-provided PDF received and fingerprinted. Availability, source review and adoption remain separate.

facts.statement: Measured neutralYb6snp3P2 n12–19 and two perturbers. TableI lifetimes149,172,1560,2700,3000,1160,2180,2640ns for n12–19; two perturbers328/100ns. Not65S data.

Authors estimate about10% overall accuracy including statistical scatter and estimated systematic errors; LN2-cooled shield change comparable to uncertainties; room-temperature lifetimes plotted. No explicit171Yb isotope/F assignment.
